title: Figure 3: Motion of UFO Across the Field of View – plotted tracks, "Utah" film
description: Two hand-plotted zigzag tracks, labeled a) and b), drawn as connected points with direction arrows showing an object's path across the camera's field of view. The rotated caption reads "Figure 3. Motion of UFO Across the Field of View, 1/16 Second Interval, 0.01 Radians/Inch." From "Photogrammetric Analysis of 'Utah' Film," page 9, Serial 02.
